simple.meaning: זוּב (zûwb) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to flow freely (as water), i.e. (specifically) to have a (sexual) flux ; figuratively, to waste away; also to overflow.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 42 times in Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 6 more, beginning at Exodus 3:8. The surrounding contexts include family, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זוּב (H2100) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: זוּב (zûwb) / H2100 is traced through Exodus 3:8, Exodus 3:17, Exodus 13:5, Exodus 33:3 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to flow freely (as water), i.e. (specifically) to have a (sexual) flux ; figuratively, to waste away; also to overflow
definitions.usage: flow, gush out, have a (running) issue, pine away, run.
definitions.full: H2100. zub [ זוּב ] verb flow, gush (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic דִּיב דּוּב, , , all used often in sense 4 below; Arabic (medial ) melt, dissolve, flow ) — only Qal Imperfect יָזוּב Lev 15:25 etc.; Participle זָב Jer 49:9 f. זָבָ֫ה Lev 15:19 etc.; — 1 flow, gush (poetry), of water from the smitten rock Psa 78:20 (|| שָׁטַף ), 105:41 (|| הָלַךְ ), Isa 48:21 (|| נָזַל ). 2 Participle frequently in וּדְבַשׁ חָלָב זָבַת (אֶרֶץ) , always of promised land, Exod 3:8 , 17 ; 13:5 (all J) 33:3 ; Num 13:27 ; 14:8 ; 16:13-14 , (all J E) Deut 6:3 ; 11:9 ; 26:9 , 15 ; 27:3 ; 31:20 ; Josh 5:6 (D) Lev 20:24 (H) Jer 11:5 ; 32:22 ; Ezek 20:6 , 15 (in last two insert ᵐ5 ארץ Co); עִמְקֵךְ זָב Jer 49:4 (fertile valley of Ammon). 3 figurative flow away = pine away (from hunger) Lam 4:9 . 4 flow , of issue from woman (all P), Lev 15:25 דָּמָהּ זוֺב יָזוּב (see ווֺב ); especially have an issue ( flux, gleet ), of woman 15:25 ; and 15:19 ( זָבָה תִּהְיֶה ); usually of man, 2Sam 3:29 (|| מְצֹרָע ); elsewhere P, Lev 15:2 מִבִּשָׂרוֺ זָב ; with cognate accusative 15:33 ; ordinarily Participle זָב one that has an issue 15:4 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 32 (all P), 22:4 (H; || צָרוּעַ ); also Num 5:2 (P; || id. )
